body:
Worker rule (Termal::BarA1). Revision 2026-10-31, after Fable2 #974. It supersedes the 2026-10-19 rule, which predates the launcher change.

The full launcher (`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full`) now prepares private UI dependencies itself. Its `ui-dependencies` preflight runs `npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund` in the candidate's ui/ (docs/test.md, "Before those five stages"). So a FRESH worktree with NO ui\node_modules is the correct state for a full gate. Do NOT run a manual `npm ci` there: an existing installation is reused only when npm's installed lock metadata matches the source lock, and a stale or partial one makes setup fail without modification.

Pre-flight, reads only:
- ui\node_modules absent (it will be installed) or a matching earlier launcher install;
- never a junction or symlink, since an outbound node_modules link is refused.

The preflight install adds a few minutes to the gate.

The old failure mode (ENOENT on ui\node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc, test-c85d2a3d, 2026-10-19) came from a root whose junction I had unlinked, under the older launcher.
